headline: Pakistan KSE-100 Index Gains 600 Points on Commercial Bank and Energy Buying
summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange benchmark KSE-100 Index rose 591.58 points, or 0.33%, to reach 177,974.15 in early Monday trading. Sector buying was concentrated in commercial banking, fertilizer, and oil exploration stocks.
why: The KSE-100 Index is Pakistan's benchmark equity index, tracking the largest listed companies across major sectors.

impacts.name: KSE-100 Index
impacts.why: The KSE-100 index gained nearly 600 points on widespread sector buying.
